verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gazebo integrates with ROS through ros_gz and exposes simulations to external code over Gazebo Transport message passing. This implies robot software can drive the simulator from the outside, as it would drive real hardware. No evidence states that the same code runs unchanged on sim and real robots. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sim-to-real workflow without code changes, hardware-abstraction or interface-parity details (e.g. ros2_control or matching topics and messages between sim and hardware), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
